description:
Create a new Account Review in Eramba for the quarterly access review cycle. 

Navigate to the 'Account Reviews' module (typically found under Security Operations or Compliance). Click 'Add' or 'New' to create a record with the following details:
- Name/Title: 'Q1 2025 Core Banking Access Review'
- Description: 'Quarterly review of all user access privileges for the Core Banking Platform as required by SOX Section 404 internal controls over financial reporting. Scope includes all Active Directory service accounts, application-level roles, and privileged database access. Review must be completed by March 31, 2025.'
- Review/Deadline Date: '2025-03-31' (if field exists)
- Owner/Reviewer: 'admin' (if field exists)

Save the record once filled.
